description:
Who owns property around an address in the Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, from county tax records, and what else each owner holds. Covers owners of two or more parcels; a one-parcel owner is not in this file. Default radius 300 ft; omit the address for the market-wide list. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Who owns 500 Washington Ave S, Minneapolis?"
- "Which companies own the most parcels around Lake Street?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

cut.description: all: every owner with 2+ parcels; big: ten or more parcels; entity: companies and institutions; land: owners of vacant land. Default all.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: who_owns_this_property
title: Who Owns This Property
